HOW IT WORKS

「Microcurrent」+ 「Radiofrequency」+「Infrared Light」+「Red LED Light」

4-In-1 Technologies

In the morning before makeup, use Firming and Lifting Mode to remove morning puffiness, strengthen muscle, lift face, and improve cellular metabolism.

In the evening before sleep, amplify skincare product absorption effectiveness, minimize wrinkles, and stimulate collagen with RF, Red light, and Infrared light.

Repeat this ritual 2-3 times a week to achieve visibly tighter skin.

Learn More

「Eye」+「Jawline」+「Face」

Exquisite sculpt from every angle

Unleash the awe-inspiring power and experience ultimate facial rejuvenation with the upgraded R3 Turbo. Elevating the power from 8W to an astonishing 15W, targeting and eliminating wrinkles in every facial zone, including tear troughs, under-eye bags, dark circles, and nasolabial folds.

Repeat this ritual 2-3 times, with Eye+Jawline+Face model for a week to see effects of each part faster.

Learn More

The world's first stamping RF facial device:

Fractional Rotation RF Technology, generate 18.4J energy and penetrating to a depth of 3.5mm into the dermis with greater energy uniformity for professional and effective anti-aging.

It delivers superior energy concentration, intensity, and uniformity of heating effects even from a distance. Safe, effective, and remarkably easy to use, leading to collagen regeneration levels of up to 90.93% in 7 days.

Normal state: 3 times a week

Learn More

Built-in four light waves and three modes

To improve the appearance of photoaged skin through a non-invasive mechanism known as photobiomodulation, triggering physical and chemical events in the skin that range from collagen synthesis (red light), and acne reduction (blue light), to improve wound healing & skin rejuvenation (yellow light), and accelerating the metabolism of the skin(infrared light).

It is recommended that the accumulated phototherapy should not exceed 30 minutes a day.

Learn More
